Maya: Heads-up: onboarding 'galilean-lite-13b' (llama->gemma-like) shows rotary/head-scale shape mismatch after GPTQ q4_0. Minimal repro below.

Maya: Repro:
```bash
# convert + quantize
python convert.py --src ckpt/galilean --dst galilean-lite --out model.pt
python quantize.py --model model.pt --scheme q4_0 --out model.q4
python run_minirepro.py --model model.q4 --prompt \"Paris is the capital of\" --max-tokens 6 --dump-logits --dump-kv
```
Observed: occasional glued tokens and duplicate eos tokens; attention in head 4 shows phase-warp vs FP16.

Jon: Paste tokenized ids + logits diff and KV index snippet. Also check `rotary_scale` tensor shapes pre/post quant.

Maya: Quick dump:
```nlogit_diff_mean: 0.013
example_ids: [17, 202, 445, 2]
example_tokens: [\"Paris\", \"is\", \"the\", \"</s>\"]
q4_output_tokens: [\"Paris\", \"is\", \"the</s>\"]
rotary_shape_pre: [32,64]
rotary_shape_post_meta: [2048]
```

Priya: That flattening explains per-head phase errors. Converter flattened (num_heads, head_dim) into 1D during packing. Also check tokenizer normalization; a few byte-sequence aliases were duplicated in a previous run.

Sam: For triage I added a runtime fallback: if rotary tensor is 1D and num_heads/head_dim known, rebuild per-head inv_freq and reshape. Local run: fixes small prompts, lexicon smoke drops failures from 14->4. Perf penalty ~+2ms/token.

Maya: eval-bot: lexicon-smoke on model.q4 -> 4/432 failures remain (diacritics + long-sentinel boundary). Report: https://internal/reports/8001112223
